title: Reel Madness charters

services.name: Charter Boat
services.desc: 6hr trip is a trolling trip for inshore species such as King mackerel, spanish mackerel, jack, crevelle and ling. Great trip to test the waters before jumping into a longer day. 6hr trip for federal water red snapper(in season) along with some trolling while still doing a shorter day. 6 hour trips can also be scheduled in afternoon. Probably our most popular trip in July-Nov. This trip allows us to fish around deep water shrimpboats for the fish that follow them. often we find blackfin tuna, dorado and ling.
